meta.purpose: English display labels for world option ids. Participants read the Chinese labels (rq3_labels_zh.json); this file supplies the English line shown beneath it in Unity and the English rendering of survey materials for the dissertation appendix and ethics record. Presentation only — no scorer or model reads this file.
meta.extend: add a location or action to data/world.json, then add its label here and in rq3_labels_zh.json
